# Preface {.unnumbered}

This is a work-in-progress thesis on gravitational-wave data analysis.

The chapters should be developed as follows:

- Part: Gravitational wave data analysis
	- Gravitational waveforms and their parameter space
	- The gravitational wave likelihood
		- Matched filtering
	- Nested sampling
	- Acceleration techniques
		- Analytical marginalization
		- Numerical marginalization (as in BAYESTAR)
		- Likelihood acceleration
		- Prior compression à la supernest
- Part: Multibanding
	- LGWA project description
	- Multibanding and PE in the SSB
	- LGWA PE
- Part: Multimessenger science
	- Inclination angles in BAYESTAR
	- IACT - EW synergies
